description: Machine-readable design tokens. The `contrast` gate reads this file. STATUS IS `placeholder`: the structure is final and the pipeline can be built and tested against it, but the values are provisional and arrive from the design deliverable (docs/design/DESIGN-BRIEF.md). The gate treats `placeholder` as report-only; it becomes blocking when status is `approved`.

surface.base.role: The page. Warm off-white, deliberately near-neutral.

text.primary.role: Body and headings. Sumi-inspired, never pure black.

text.tertiary.role: Placeholders and disabled text. AA at large sizes only — never used for essential information.

border.focus.role: Focus ring. Must be visible against every surface — checked by the contrast gate against all surface.* tokens.

accent.base.role: The single accent, drawn from indigo. Used sparingly and never adjacent to a colour sample.

text.inverse.role: Text on accent and dark surfaces.

swatch.border.role: The border of a colour sample. Mid-neutral so it biases neither light nor dark samples.

swatch.separator.role: MANDATORY neutral gap between a colour sample and any adjacent coloured element. Simultaneous contrast makes this functional, not decorative.

dark._note: Derived from light by transforming L while preserving C and H, per ADR-0020. Values are generated, not authored; exceptions are recorded in `exceptions` below. Populated on design approval.

status._note: Every status token MUST pair with an icon token. A status expressible only as colour violates NFR-9, and pairing them here makes that impossible rather than merely discouraged.

cvdPairs._note: Semantic pairs that must remain distinguishable under simulated CVD. Checked by the `cvd` gate at the minimum separation below. The product's own interface is held to the standard it applies to outfits.

spacing._note: Base unit and scale. 間 (ma) means the larger steps are used more than in a typical product. Populated on design approval.

typography._note: Tabular numerals everywhere — colour values appear in columns and must align. Japanese needs a separate line-height scale at the same size. Populated on design approval.

radius._note: swatch is 0 and stays 0. A rounded sample changes perceived area and therefore perceived colour.

motion._note: Every duration collapses to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion. Motion must never alter a colour mid-transition. Populated on design approval.
